news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam Trailer Lock Plans
news.summary: Makers of the upcoming family drama Aadarsha Kutumbam are reportedly eyeing an October 4 trailer release. Starring Venkatesh and directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the movie heads to theatres on October 9, 2026.
body: The collaborative project bringing together actor Venkatesh and director Trivikram Srinivas, titled Aadarsha Kutumbam, is preparing for its theatrical arrival. Ahead of its scheduled release, word has emerged regarding promotional rollouts for the family drama.

Sources indicate that the creative team intends to launch the official theatrical trailer on October 4. This upcoming preview is anticipated to build further anticipation among fans and audiences just days ahead of the film's premiere.

Scheduled to hit big screens on October 9, 2026, the movie features Srinidhi Shetty as the female lead. The supporting cast includes Nivetha Pethuraj, Nara Rohith, Pujita Ponnada, Rao Ramesh, Yuvina Parthavi, and Satya.
Aadarsha Kutumbam has been bankrolled by Haarika & Hassine Creations, with music composed by Thaman. The upcoming trailer launch is expected to amplify momentum for the high-profile collaboration.

news.title: Kajal Aggarwal's The India Story Lands on OTT in Telugu and Tamil
news.summary: The Kajal Aggarwal and Shreyas Talpade starrer The India Story is now streaming in Telugu and Tamil on JioHotstar. While the film previously had a Hindi theatrical run, its regional language versions bypassed cinemas entirely.
body: The India Story, starring Kajal Aggarwal and Shreyas Talpade, has officially landed on JioHotstar in Telugu and Tamil languages. Although the makers initially planned a multilingual theatrical release, only the Hindi version made it to cinema halls, where it experienced a muted box-office response.

Following its initial Hindi-language digital debut on the platform, the streaming service has now expanded availability to include the Telugu and Tamil tracks. This gives the feature a fresh avenue to engage viewers in linguistic markets that missed out on a theatrical release.

Directed by Chettan DK, the project also features a supporting ensemble including Manish Wadhwa, Murli Sharma, Atul Tiwari, and Kamlesh Sawant. The film was produced by Sagar B Shinde, with a soundtrack composed by Mangesh Dhakde.
With its arrival on digital platforms in multiple regional languages, attention now shifts to whether the feature can cultivate a stronger reception among home-viewing audiences.

news.title: Mani Ratnam's Geethanjali 4K Re-Release Locks New Date
news.summary: The 4K restored version of Mani Ratnam's classic romantic drama Geethanjali, starring Nagarjuna and Girija Shettar, is locked for a November 13, 2026 theatrical re-release following restoration delays.
body: The remastered 4K version of the classic romantic drama Geethanjali has secured a new theatrical release date. The film is now scheduled to arrive in theatres on November 13, 2026.

The project was initially slated to return to the big screen on August 28 to coincide with lead actor Nagarjuna's birthday on August 29. However, the team chose to postpone the rollout to carry out additional restoration work aimed at achieving top-tier picture and sound quality.

Directed by Mani Ratnam, Geethanjali originally released in 1989 and remains his only direct Telugu film. The narrative follows two terminally ill individuals who find love and embrace life despite knowing their time together is short.

The upcoming re-release will highlight PC Sreeram's cinematography of Ooty's landscapes and Ilaiyaraaja's score, enhanced by contemporary theatrical technology to offer both nostalgia and an upgraded viewing experience.

news.title: Junior NTR Praises Fahadh Faasil's Dont Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: Actor NTR has lauded the upcoming film Dont Trouble The Trouble, praising debut director Shashank Yeleti, child artist Sara, and composer Kaala Bhairava ahead of its October 2, 2026 release.
body: As anticipation builds for the release of Dont Trouble The Trouble, starring Fahadh Faasil, prominent industry figures have come forward to share their appreciation for the project. Among them is actor NTR, who expressed high praise for the film ahead of its October 2 premiere.

NTR commended debut director Shashank Yeleti for handling emotional elements in a captivating manner in his first outing. He also singled out child artist Sara for a heartfelt performance that stands out in the narrative.

Furthermore, NTR highlighted Kaala Bhairava's background music for elevating the film to another level, describing the viewing experience from the police station sequence to the climax as an emotional roller coaster suitable for families.
Produced by Karthikeya, the film has received pre-release appreciation from multiple top stars, including Mahesh Babu, building strong momentum for its theatrical run.

news.title: Priyanka Chopra and Saif Ali Khan Roped In for Ritesh Batra's International Project
news.summary: Bollywood stars Priyanka Chopra and Saif Ali Khan are reportedly collaborating for the first time in an upcoming international film. Acclaimed director Ritesh Batra will helm the project, marking a fresh on-screen pairing for the two established actors.
body: Bollywood actors Priyanka Chopra and Saif Ali Khan are set to share the screen for the very first time in an upcoming international film. Industry reports indicate that the project will be directed by acclaimed filmmaker Ritesh Batra, widely known for his critically praised work on films like The Lunchbox and Photograph.

While both performers have enjoyed extensive and successful careers in Indian cinema, they have never worked together in lead roles until now. This novel casting choice has immediately sparked significant curiosity and interest among fans across the entertainment landscape.

Priyanka Chopra has increasingly built a prominent global profile through major international ventures including Citadel and Heads of State, alongside her upcoming Indian comeback film, Varanasi. Meanwhile, Saif Ali Khan continues to navigate a diverse career balancing commercial cinema and content-driven roles, following his recent appearance in Priyadarshan's Haiwaan.

Specific plot details and production timelines for Batra's international venture remain under wraps. As both actors embark on this unique collaboration, trade analysts and audiences will be watching closely to see what subject matter the creative team tackles.

news.title: Sandeep Reddy Vanga-Backed Romanchakam Arrives on Netflix
news.summary: The romantic drama Romanchakam, backed by Sandeep Reddy Vanga and produced by Pranav Reddy Vanga, has officially landed on Netflix. Starring Sumanth Ashwin and Ananthika Sanilkumar, the film is now available in multiple languages following its theatrical run.
body: Romanchakam, a feature film supported by prominent filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga and produced under his father Pranav Reddy Vanga's banner Bhadrakali Pictures, has officially transitioned to the digital space. The movie is currently streaming on Netflix in multiple languages.

Headlined by Sumanth Ashwin and Ananthika Sanilkumar, the project also features a supporting cast that includes Narendra Ravi, Venkatesh Kakumanu, Mani Aegurla, Sai Sohan, and Upendra Limaye. Vasuki Vaibhav composed the musical score for the production.

Despite extensive promotional efforts by Sandeep Reddy Vanga prior to its theatrical release, the movie faced a muted response from younger audiences in cinemas. The transition to Netflix gives the romantic drama a fresh platform to connect with a wider demographic of viewers.

Streaming platforms have increasingly become a crucial second window for films that fail to capture box-office momentum during their theatrical windows. Industry observers will monitor how Romanchakam fares with home audiences on the service.

news.title: Mayuri Film Distributors Makes Major Comeback with Thella Kaagitham
news.summary: Mayuri Film Distributors, a prominent distribution banner under the Ramoji Group, is returning to theatrical operations after a lengthy hiatus. The company is handling the wide release of the content-driven film Thella Kaagitham across Krishna district.
body: Mayuri Film Distributors, a historical distribution house associated with the Ramoji Group, is officially staging a major return to the theatrical distribution sector. The company has selected the content-driven project Thella Kaagitham as its comeback vehicle.

The distribution house is preparing a wide release strategy for the film across Krishna district, alongside a planned worldwide rollout and paid premieres. This move brings renewed attention to the company's legacy of systematic, corporate-style distribution operations.

Established during the 1990s, Mayuri pioneered a structured approach to film distribution by analyzing content, identifying target audiences, and understanding regional viewing preferences. At its peak, the company maintained an extensive network of 19 distribution offices across Andhra Pradesh.

By backing a content-focused feature rather than a conventional commercial star vehicle for its return, Mayuri has generated substantial trade interest. The upcoming campaign will test whether its legacy network and corporate strategy still resonate in today's theatrical market.

news.title: Karthi's Spy Thriller Sardar 2 Makes Swift OTT Debut on Amazon Prime Video
news.summary: Karthi's action spy thriller Sardar 2 has arrived on Amazon Prime Video just three weeks after its theatrical release. Directed by PS Mithran, the film aims to find a broader audience on streaming following a disappointing box-office run.
body: Karthi's high-profile spy action thriller Sardar 2 has made a rapid transition to digital platforms, arriving on Amazon Prime Video merely three weeks after its initial theatrical debut. The Tamil feature is accessible to streaming subscribers in multiple languages, including Telugu.

Helmed by director PS Mithran, the movie features Karthi performing in dual roles. The supporting cast boasts prominent names such as SJ Suryah, Malavika Mohanan, Ashika Ranganath, and Rajisha Vijayan, with production handled by S Lakshman Kumar and Ishan Saksena under Prince Pictures and IVY Entertainment.

Released initially amidst heavy expectations and substantial hype, the film struggled to resonate with audiences in theatres and concluded its big-screen run on a soft note. The swift OTT release window provides the creative team with an immediate opportunity to recoup audience interest.

As digital platforms continue to shrink the gap between theatrical and home viewing windows, projects like Sardar 2 look to streaming algorithms and wider multi-language accessibility to redefine their commercial footprints.

news.title: Breakout Performances: How 'The Paradise' Shined Light on Kranthi Balivada and Vishika
news.summary: While Sampoornesh Babu took on a routine role in 'The Paradise', supporting actors Kranthi Balivada and Vishika managed to capture the audience's spotlight. Kranthi gained attention for her voice work and minor role, while Vishika impressed viewers with her strong performance in the film's second half.
body: In the lead-up to the release of 'The Paradise', actor Sampoornesh Babu placed heavy bets on his participation, stepping away from other projects to focus entirely on the venture. Known for his breakout work in 'Hrudaya Kaleyam', Sampoornesh anticipated that playing a character named Biryani would propel his career forward and open doors to more substantial roles. However, post-release evaluations revealed a different outcome as the character turned out to be a routine part lacking significant dramatic scope for the actor to showcase his skills.

Instead, the film served as a breakout platform for other talents, notably Kranthi Balivada. Playing the mother of Kayadu Lohar's character, Kranthi also contributed crucial voice work, including dubbing for Sonali Kulkarni—who portrayed Nani's mother, Sammakka—and delivering voiceovers for other major projects like the KGF franchise. Her prominent dialogue in the teaser praising her co-star as a single-take artist quickly gained widespread traction across social media platforms, elevating her industry profile from her early career beginnings as a biochemistry lecturer and anchor.

Another performer earning widespread acclaim is young actor Vishika, whose impactful presence in the narrative's second half caught the attention of viewers. Having previously appeared in projects such as 'Court', 'Korean Kanakaraju', 'Patang', and 'Committee Kurrollu', Vishika's latest showing has expanded her footprint in the industry.

Ultimately, while Sampoornesh's inclusion in a project of this scale marked a notable filmography addition, it fell short of serving as a game-changer. The development highlights how supporting artists can occasionally overshadow established expectations, prompting a reevaluation of how performers approach secondary character arcs in major productions.

news.title: Stree 3 Officially Confirmed for 2028 Release Following Mahavatar
news.summary: Producer Dinesh Vijan has confirmed that 'Stree 3' will begin filming toward the end of next year, targeting a theatrical release in 2028. Before tackling the threequel, director Amar Kaushik will helm the ambitious mythological project 'Mahavatar', focusing on Bhagwan Parshuram.
body: Producer Dinesh Vijan and actor Rajkummar Rao recently appeared at FICCI Frames 2026 to share updates regarding their upcoming slate and the expanding horror-comedy universe. During the event, Vijan outlined the production timeline for the highly anticipated continuation of the 'Stree' franchise, confirming that the third installment is officially locked for a 2028 theatrical debut.

According to Vijan, director Amar Kaushik remains central to the franchise's development. Kaushik is currently slated to direct the mythological drama 'Mahavatar', which centers on the story of Bhagwan Parshuram, beginning in late January. Production on 'Mahavatar' is expected to conclude around June, after which the team will immediately pivot toward the horror-comedy universe.

The producer revealed that 'Stree 3' will officially go on floors by the end of next year, with eyes on potential festival windows such as Independence Day or Christmas in 2028. While noting that the script is already finalized, Vijan kept plot specifics tightly under wraps, teasing that the narrative trajectory will completely upend audience expectations regarding where the story begins and ends.

news.title: Ajay Devgn’s 'Drishyam 3' Faces the Ultimate Test for Franchise Conclusion
news.summary: As Ajay Devgn prepares for the Hindi release of 'Drishyam 3', the film carries the heavy burden of providing a definitive conclusion that the Malayalam counterpart's ending arguably missed. The makers have officially declared this installment as the final chapter, heightening anticipation for Georgekutty's cinematic fate.
body: The 'Drishyam' series stands as one of Indian cinema's most prominent thriller franchises, bridging regional industries with high-stakes narratives. While the Malayalam original spearheaded by Mohanlal set the benchmark, its recent third installment drew mixed reactions from viewers despite posting strong box office numbers in Kerala. A segment of the audience felt the narrative left too many doors open rather than delivering a definitive resolution to Georgekutty's protracted ordeal.

Attention now pivots to the Hindi adaptation headlined by Ajay Devgn, which arrives in theaters on October 2, 2026. Recognizing the audience's desire for closure, the creative team has officially confirmed that this third chapter will serve as the absolute finale for the franchise in Hindi. This explicit promise has substantially raised the stakes for the project.

The primary hurdle for Devgn and his collaborators will be crafting a cohesive, emotionally resonant finale that addresses long-standing narrative threads. With advanced ticket bookings indicating healthy early interest, a well-executed conclusion could cement the Hindi franchise as a textbook example of a satisfying multi-part adaptation, successfully avoiding the ambiguity that drew criticism in earlier iterations.

news.title: The Toxicity Trap: How Premiere Night Negativity Is Threatening Movie Openings
news.summary: Recent high-profile releases have highlighted a growing trend of intense, accelerated negativity during theatrical premiere shows. Driven by social media algorithms and amplified by ticket price hikes, this immediate backlash places immense pressure on filmmakers and shifts audience mindsets before regular runs even begin.
body: The atmosphere surrounding major theatrical premieres has shifted dramatically, characterized by a level of instant scrutiny and hostility that frequently catches creators off guard. This phenomenon, recently observed during premieres for projects like 'The Paradise' as well as earlier titles such as 'Peddi' and 'Toxic', demonstrates a broader behavioral change among audiences and commentators alike.

Historically, fan rivalries existed—such as supporters of opposing stars voicing disapproval—while general audiences maintained independent judgment. Today, however, social media incentives have transformed post-release discussions. The pursuit of online reach encourages rapid-fire negative posting, with accounts racing to highlight flaws first. Digital reviewers frequently lean into harsh takedowns because negative critiques often secure higher engagement than balanced assessments.

This climate is further exacerbated by the combination of premiere screenings and ticket price hikes. When viewers pay elevated prices for early shows, their patience diminishes considerably, and they enter auditoriums with heightened expectations and heightened skepticism. Minor flaws are magnified, and negative narratives spread across platforms within hours, creating an extremely stressful environment for production teams.

While sub-par content will always invite genuine criticism, the sheer speed and intensity of premiere-night negativity present a distinct challenge for the industry. Producers opting for early premieres and price increases must carefully weigh whether their content can withstand immediate, microscopic scrutiny in an unforgiving digital ecosystem.

news.title: Mahesh Babu Praises Fahadh Faasil Starrer 'Dont Trouble The Trouble'
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu has shared an enthusiastic review of the upcoming film 'Dont Trouble The Trouble' ahead of its theatrical release on October 2. He commended lead actor Fahadh Faasil, director Shashank Yeleti, and producer SS Karthikeya for crafting a warm and entertaining cinematic experience.
body: Ahead of its scheduled theatrical release on October 2, the upcoming film 'Dont Trouble The Trouble' has received an early endorsement from Superstar Mahesh Babu. Following a private screening, the actor took to social media to share his thoughts on the project, describing it as a complete and deeply moving cinematic experience.

Mahesh Babu offered high praise for lead actor Fahadh Faasil, labeling him a stupendous performer and expressing admiration for his continuous evolution and experimentation on screen. He also highlighted the dynamic between Fahadh and young co-star Ssara Palekar, noting how convincingly their characters inhabit every moment of the film.

The actor extended his appreciation to director Shashank Yeleti for building a unique world, alongside producer SS Karthikeya and Shobu Yarlagadda for bringing the project to life. With the film arriving in cinemas soon, this detailed early review has generated significant additional attention among moviegoers and industry observers alike.

news.title: Hilarious Glimpse Unveiled for Shiva Kandukuri’s 'Talcum Powder'
news.summary: The makers of 'Talcum Powder' have released a humorous glimpse into the upcoming film starring Shiva Kandukuri and Drishika Chander. Directed by Sainath Ponna and presented by Raj Kandukuri, the project is slated for a grand theatrical release on November 13, 2026.
body: Makers of the upcoming Telugu film 'Talcum Powder' have released an introductory glimpse, offering audiences a humorous first look at the project. Starring Shiva Kandukuri in the lead alongside female lead Drishika Chander, the movie is directed by Sainath Ponna and presented by veteran producer Raj Kandukuri.

The newly released video snippet introduces a drug peddler named Bunty, setting up a comedic narrative involving both local law enforcement and the drug mafia. The promotional material also features appearances by Venkatesh Maha and A Jeevan Kumar, while Raj Kandukuri makes a notable on-screen presence.

Behind the camera, the film features music composed by Osho V, with cinematography managed by GV Ajay Kumar and editing by Surya Ponnapalli. Following the positive reception of the initial glimpse, 'Talcum Powder' is locked for a grand theatrical arrival on November 13, 2026.

news.title: Mahesh Babu Shares High Praise For 'Dont Trouble The Trouble'
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu has delivered a glowing review of 'Dont Trouble The Trouble' following a private screening. He lauded Fahadh Faasil's performance and congratulated debut producer SS Karthikeya on the film's October 2 release.
body: Telugu cinema icon Mahesh Babu has shared an appreciative review of the upcoming film 'Dont Trouble The Trouble', directed by Shashank Yeleti. After watching the movie at a private screening, the actor praised its rare sense of warmth, balancing entertainment and emotional depth.

The actor singled out Malayalam star Fahadh Faasil for his brilliant performance alongside young actor Ssara Palekar, noting that their interactions breathe life into the narrative. He also congratulated producer SS Karthikeya on his debut venture alongside co-producer Shobu Yarlagadda.

With the film hitting theaters on October 2, Mahesh Babu's endorsement adds considerable credibility and pre-release traction. The project has also drawn attention due to Karthikeya's family ties to renowned filmmaker SS Rajamouli, with whom Mahesh Babu is currently collaborating on an upcoming project.

news.title: Telugu Release of Nivin Pauly and Soori's Sanchari Postponed Due to Title Issue
news.summary: The Telugu version of the upcoming film starring Nivin Pauly and Soori, titled Sanchari, has been postponed from its scheduled release. Directed by Ram, the film's makers announced that the hold is due to a title issue, with a new release date to be announced shortly.
body: The theatrical release of Sanchari, the Telugu dubbed version of the Tamil film 112 Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai, has been officially put on hold. Directed by Ram, the project features Nivin Pauly in his immediate release following a major industry hit, alongside Kollywood actor Soori in a crucial role.

The movie was initially slated to hit the big screens simultaneously with its original Tamil version. However, last-minute complications regarding the title forced the makers to delay the Telugu rollout. A revised release schedule will be communicated to audiences shortly.

Alongside Nivin Pauly and Soori, the film also features actress Anjali in a prominent capacity. The project is backed by producer Suresh Kamatchi under V House Productions, with musical score composed by Yuvan Shankar Raja.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Crosses ₹150 Crore Worldwide as It Eyes Extended Weekend Boost
news.summary: Nani's action drama The Paradise has grossed over ₹150 crore worldwide after completing its first week in theatres. While Nizam remains a strong territory, the film faces slow collections in parts of Andhra Pradesh, prompting star Nani to undertake promotional tours ahead of an extended holiday weekend.
body: Nani's latest cinematic outing, The Paradise, has concluded its first week at the box office with a worldwide gross collection exceeding ₹150 crore. The film registered record opening numbers, marking the biggest start for the actor's career.

Despite a strong initial run, collections have tapered off across several regions. While the Nizam territory continues to perform steadily and has broken even, multiple areas in Andhra Pradesh are struggling to meet their financial targets. To bolster momentum, lead actor Nani has actively stepped up promotional efforts, touring Andhra Pradesh to encourage theatrical viewership.

Looking ahead, the makers are banking on an upcoming long weekend advantage driven by the Gandhi Jayanti holiday on Friday. Despite fresh competition arriving in theatres in the form of new releases like Simga and Don't Trouble The Trouble, the extended window provides a crucial opportunity for the film to improve its recovery standing.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Stuns on Filmfare Cover While Gear Up for Upcoming Projects
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu has captured attention with her latest high-fashion appearance on the cover of Filmfare. Amid a challenging box office year, the actress continues to maintain her professional momentum as she prepares for her upcoming big-screen appearances.
body: Taapsee Pannu has once again turned heads with a striking fashion spread, featuring prominently on the latest cover of Filmfare. Showcasing a variety of high-end looks—ranging from a sky-blue sequin mini dress to a shimmering gold gown and a chic white bandeau set—the actress drew widespread praise for her versatile styling.

On the professional front, the actress has faced a difficult theatrical year following underperforming box-office numbers for her previous releases, Advocate Raavi and Gandhari. However, she remains focused on her upcoming slate.

Taapsee is currently engaged in shooting for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, where she essays the role of ACP Komal Sharma. Fans and industry trackers are anticipating her return to form with her upcoming theatrical ventures.

news.title: Akshay Kumar and Priyadarshan's Crime Thriller Haiwaan Suffers Heavy Box Office Defeat
news.summary: Akshay Kumar's latest theatrical release Haiwaan, directed by Priyadarshan, has wrapped up its box office run with under Rs. 10 crore in lifetime collections. The crime thriller struggled with weak word-of-mouth and pre-release criticism over being a remake, leading to a major commercial disappointment.
body: The crime thriller Haiwaan, starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan under the direction of Priyadarshan, has emerged as one of the major box office disasters in recent Indian cinema. The film commenced its theatrical run with a lukewarm opening day collection of just over Rs. 2.5 crore nett. Despite the weekend momentum bringing in an additional Rs. 6.7 crore nett, the project failed to sustain its numbers.

Following the opening weekend, audience turnout dropped sharply, bringing the final lifetime collections to a disappointing Rs. 9 crore nett. For a high-profile production featuring leading stars, these commercial figures have fallen well below expectations and sent ripples of concern across the industry.

Market analysts noted that the film faced challenges prior to its release, encountering negative audience sentiment over being an official remake of a Malayalam feature released a decade earlier. Coupled with weak word-of-mouth reviews, the project struggled to build any lasting box office traction.

Reflecting on the commercial outcome, director Priyadarshan has reportedly decided to steer away from non-comedy projects with Akshay Kumar in future collaborations. The unexpected failure highlights the shifting preferences of audiences regarding cinematic remakes and thriller narratives.

news.title: Ravi Teja's Irumudi Emerges as Global OTT Leader on Netflix
news.summary: Following a successful theatrical run, Ravi Teja's starrer Irumudi has captured the global spotlight by securing the No. 1 position among non-English movies on Netflix. The film has crossed 6.8 million views worldwide, extending its commercial success from the big screen to digital platforms.
body: Irumudi, headlined by Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja and directed by Shiva Nirvana, continues its successful run by conquering digital streaming audiences globally. Produced by Mythri Movie Makers and featuring a cast including Priya Bhavani Shankar and Baby Nakshatra, the film previously completed a profitable theatrical run for producers, distributors, and exhibitors alike.

After transitioning to Netflix on the 18th of the month, the movie quickly climbed the streaming charts. It has officially captured the No. 1 spot globally in the non-English films category, accumulating a massive viewership of over 6.8 million streams to date.

Industry observers note that Irumudi's trajectory represents a rare occurrence where a title achieves strong theatrical profitability and simultaneously sustains high engagement on digital platforms. This dual success points to a robust connection with audiences across different viewing mediums.

news.title: Shiva Kandukuri's Talcum Powder First Glimpse Unveils Quirky Crime Dramedy
news.summary: National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri is backing the upcoming crime dramedy Talcum Powder, starring Shiva Kandukuri and directed by Sainath Ponna. The newly released first glimpse introduces a chaotic world centered on a drug peddler named Bunty, ahead of its November 13 theatrical release.
body: Presented by National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri under the Dharmapatha Creations banner, the upcoming project Talcum Powder has launched its promotional campaign with an introductory glimpse titled The First Sprinkle. The film is written and directed by Sainath Ponna and features Shiva Kandukuri in the male lead alongside Drishika Chander.

The newly released promotional video sets up a contemporary crime dramedy centered around Bunty, a drug peddler who finds himself entangled in severe trouble following a critical mistake. With both law enforcement and a group of goons pursuing him, the narrative promises a series of unpredictable and fast-paced complications.

Alongside the lead pair, the movie features supporting performances from actors like Venkatesh Maha and A Jeevan Kumar. The technical crew includes GV Ajay Kumar as the cinematographer, Osho V as the music composer, and Surya Ponnapalli handling editorial duties. Talcum Powder is scheduled to hit theaters on November 13.

news.title: Mahesh Babu Praises Fahadh Faasil's Don't Trouble The Trouble After Special Screening
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu has shared high praise for Fahadh Faasil's upcoming Telugu film Don't Trouble The Trouble, directed by Shashank Yeleti. Following a special screening, the actor commended the warm, entertaining, and deeply moving nature of the Arka Media Works production.
body: Fahadh Faasil's upcoming straight Telugu film Don't Trouble The Trouble has received a major endorsement from Superstar Mahesh Babu following a special preview screening. Directed by debutant Shashank Yeleti, the movie is produced by Shobu Yarlagadda, Prasad Devineni, and S.S. Karthikeya under Arka Media Works and Showing Business, with S.S. Rajamouli presenting.

Taking to social media, Mahesh Babu described the viewing experience as complete, beautiful, and rare in its warmth. He highlighted the film's ability to balance entertainment with emotional depth, while complimenting the lead performances of Fahadh Faasil and Ssara.

The project has steadily built momentum through high-profile industry backing, including a pre-release event graced by actor NTR. With positive early words from leading industry names, the film looks to secure strong audience interest ahead of its October 2 theatrical release.

news.title: Chandoo Mondeti Confirms Hindi-Telugu Bilingual With Rana Daggubati and Akshay Kumar
news.summary: Filmmaker Chandoo Mondeti has addressed recent speculation, confirming that he is teaming up with Rana Daggubati and Bollywood star Akshay Kumar for a Hindi-Telugu bilingual tentatively titled Mahakaal. The director clarified that Karan Johar is lined up to produce the Hindi version, while the search for a production partner for the Telugu version remains ongoing.
body: Filmmaker Chandoo Mondeti has officially cleared the air regarding extensive media reports surrounding his upcoming cinematic venture. Speaking directly about the project, the director confirmed that a collaboration with Rana Daggubati and Bollywood star Akshay Kumar is indeed moving forward as a Hindi-Telugu bilingual tentatively titled Mahakaal.

According to Mondeti, the production arrangements for the multi-language feature are currently being sorted. While Rana Daggubati informed him that Karan Johar will produce the Hindi version, the makers are still looking for a major production house to back the Telugu version. The director emphasized that the project is firmly in its initial stages, with active discussions underway regarding the story, technicians, and early pre-production workflows.

Addressing rumors that acclaimed Bollywood filmmaker Sanjay Leela Bhansali is writing the script, Mondeti firmly denied any connection. He clarified that the story and direction are entirely his own creation, noting that while he is in talks with Bhansali for a completely separate narrative, that collaboration will be announced at a later time.

Mondeti explained that the project materialized after discussions with Rana Daggubati in Mumbai, where he pitched a few ideas that ultimately led to the selection of this mythological subject. Set against the backdrop of Ujjain, the director noted that the historical and spiritual resonance of the region naturally inspired a larger-than-life narrative, rather than a deliberate attempt to mirror his previous franchise work.

news.title: Maremma OTT Release Date Locked: Maadhav's Debut Film Heads to Aha and Amazon Prime Video
news.summary: Maadhav Bhupathiraju's debut rural drama Maremma is heading to digital streaming next month. The film, which originally released in theaters on September 10, 2026, will premiere simultaneously on Aha and Amazon Prime Video on October 9, 2026.
body: The rural drama Maremma, which marked the acting debut of Maadhav Bhupathiraju—nephew of Telugu cinema star Ravi Teja—is officially making its way to digital platforms. Following its theatrical run that began on September 10, 2026, the movie is preparing for a wider audience reach via streaming.

Streaming platforms Aha and Amazon Prime Video have secured the digital rights for the film. An official announcement confirming the dual-platform release date of October 9, 2026, is anticipated shortly.

Directed by Manchala Nagaraj and produced by Mayur Reddy Bandaru, Maremma features an ensemble cast including Deepa Balu, Vikas Vasishta, Vinod Kumar, V.S. Rupa Lakshmi, and Dayanand Reddy. The film's musical score was composed by the team of Prashanth R. Vihari and Bipradeep Dutta.

news.title: Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi's 'Fauji' Release Delayed Indefinitely Amid Pending Shoots
news.summary: The much-anticipated period action drama Fauji, starring Prabhas and directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, has faced another postponement. With significant portions of filming remaining, producers are in no rush to announce a new release date.
body: The theatrical release of 'Fauji', headlined by Prabhas and directed by filmmaker Hanu Raghavapudi, has been indefinitely postponed. The project had previously been slated for a December 3 release, but persistent delays in production have pushed back the timeline.

According to production insiders, a substantial portion of the film remains incomplete. Prabhas is reportedly required to dedicate more than 60 working days to finish his remaining sequences for the movie.

Complicating the shooting schedule further are the actor's parallel commitments to Sandeep Reddy Vanga's upcoming project 'Spirit'. Fulfilling these combined obligations means the necessary 60 days of shooting for 'Fauji' could take upwards of four months, leaving the production house without a clear completion window.

Consequently, the makers are adopting a cautious approach and have chosen not to announce a revised release date until principal photography wraps entirely. While fans can still anticipate promotional material or a new poster to drop on Prabhas's birthday on October 23, any official word on a rescheduled theatrical premiere is expected to be omitted.

news.title: Karthi's Quick OTT Premieres Spark Debate Over Shrinking Theatrical Windows
news.summary: Actor Karthi's recent films have landed on streaming platforms within two to three weeks of their theatrical debuts following weak box office runs. This rapid shift to digital is raising concerns among trade analysts regarding the future sustainability of cinema halls.
body: The theatrical windows for actor Karthi's recent releases have shrunk significantly, sparking concerns across the film trade. His spy sequel 'Sardar 2' arrived on Amazon Prime Video on October 1, just 21 days after its initial theatrical run, following a struggle to attract large audiences to cinema halls.

This rapid digital transition is part of a developing pattern for the Tamil star this year. Earlier during the Sankranti festive season, his comedy-action movie 'Vaa Vaathiyar' failed to gain traction at the box office and was rushed to the same streaming platform in five languages just 14 days after hitting the big screen.

Industry norms typically dictate an exclusive theatrical window of four to eight weeks for major star-driven releases. This extended period is crucial for distributors and exhibitors to recover their financial investments through ticket sales and maintain steady footfalls.

Trade analysts warn that shortening the window to two or three weeks for underperforming films could severely damage the theatrical ecosystem. If moviegoers realize that titles will be available at home within a fortnight, opening-weekend turnout and advance bookings may experience a steep decline.
